verdict: The invariant-gauge theorem holds at all grades. The deformed fold step is an exact conjugation of the baseline step (OPID: D'_s = M_s D_s M_s^{-1}, M_s = exp(eps s phi)), so the deformed chain is the baseline chain with invariant insertions (REDUC, g = 2, 3). Invariant insertions preserve the reciprocity class (PIVOT), hence the baseline engine's induction lifts to the whole deformation family: N_g(u,eps) is reciprocal at every grade (direct: g = 1..4, REC), and the characters are exact at symbolic eps (direct: g = 4, CHAR). Combined with deformation_theory_checks (KER1: the first-order kernel is exactly the invariant-exact directions), the character-preserving deformations of the fold connection are EXACTLY the invariant-exact gauge directions, at every grade.
